_comment: Every colour literal vale.html may contain. The party palette is the game's identity (docs/AGREEMENT.md) and never changes for theming; the theme list is Ministry Precise. A new literal fails checks/run.js until it is adjudicated here — added after a retune shipped half-applied because lowercase hex in JS escaped an uppercase sweep.

allowed._partyComment: RSF and PNL carry the only two changes the party palette has ever had, ruled in S6b: both were invisible on the baize (contrast 1.90 and 1.35) and both are lifted along their own hue rather than replaced. RSF #9D0000 -> #C70000 moves 0.4 degrees of hue for contrast 1.90 -> 2.68; PNL #0000BC -> #1551FF moves 7.8 degrees for 1.35 -> 2.86. Re-measure any further proposal with tools/seats.js: the standing rule is that hue drift past ~12 degrees is a different party, not a lift.

notes.#000: alpha stencils in mask-image gradients and black overlays — not colour
notes.#fff: print stylesheet paper inversion, and one badge foreground
notes.#333: hemiMap's fallback fill for a seat beyond the colour sequence
